Political instability is a prominent feature as surveys have shown that 40 percent of the countries have had successful or attempted coups.
______ is the responsibility of the bureaucracy, another organ of the state.
Plan implementation is the responsibility of the bureaucracy, another organ of the state.
______ is referred to as a process whereby the real per capita income increases accompanied by reduction in inequalities of income and the satisfaction of the preferences of the masses as a whole.

Economic development is referred to as a process whereby the real per capita income increases accompanied by reduction in inequalities of income and the satisfaction of the preferences of the masses as a whole.
______ is the foundation of a society or what (Ake 1981) referred to as the base, and if it is strong, it will have positive impact on the political system which is the super-structure.

______ is a process of improved decision-making rather than the output of those decisions.
The essence of development is a process of improved decision- making rather than the output of those decisions.
